title: Let peace reach the mouth and the walk
summary: Holy company and Naam make speech sweet and the walk humble. Return the mouth to praise before it carries hurt.
takeaway: Return the mouth to praise before it carries hurt.
lifeApplication: Before the next message leaves your mouth, pause with one breath and choose the sentence that can still be honored tonight.

source.shortMeaning: Holy company and Naam make speech sweet and the walk humble.
source.lifeApplication: Before you answer, let your pace and tone come under remembrance.
